title.stringValue: Trade Networks with Neighboring Asian Societies

lessonRecap.stringValue: Early communities in the islands had links with other Asian societies before Spanish rule. Ships and coastal routes helped goods move. Imported ceramics found in Philippine sites help show contact with other Asian places. Some were made in China and other parts of Asia. Communities had different resources and skills. Exchange could help people obtain useful or valued goods. Maps of past trade are explanations based on evidence. They are not photographs of every ship journey. Trade brought people into contact. They could share knowledge, ideas and customs as well as goods.
